newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon rates CITIC a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon rates CITIC a buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said it is recommending a buy for CITIC Pacific Ltd and has set a target price of HK$47.30 for the share.

In its latest research report, Salomon said the company is expected to register strong growth this year due to a turnaround at subsidiary Dah Chong Hong, maiden earnings from new infrastructure projects and its property investment portfolio.

"The troubles that saw Dah Chong Hong's profits fall by 35 percent in 1995 have dissipated due to the recent turnaround in the demand for motor vehicles and the weakening yen boosting margins substantially," said analyst Anil Daswani.
Dah Chong Hong earnings will rise to HK$504 million in 1996 and HK$607 million in 1997 from HK$462 million in 1995, he said.
CITIC should benefit from its recent acquisition of a stake in China Light & Power Co and from investments in independent power projects in China, the report said.

Daswani said he is forecasting CITIC will have HK$6.99 billion in earnings in the year to December 31, 1996, including exceptional items, HK$4.48 billion in 1997 and HK$6.28 billion in 1998. CITIC had earnings of HK$3.07 billion in 1995.
The share ended Friday unchanged at HK$37.40.
